steps.step: {"blocks":[{"key":"6k37a","text":"Start with an overnight agar overlay plate that shows plaque formation.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"ci86q","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"8kvp9","text":"Using a 200 ul pipette tip, pick a plaque from the original host screening plate that plaques were discovered on. Choose a plaque that is similar in morphology and size to the majority of the other plaques on the plate.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"c9n3","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"3ddpq","text":"Mark on the plate which plaque was picked for future reference.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":17}],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"5r25a","text":"Vortex the pipette tip in 1 mL of phage buffer. Let the sample stand for at least 30 minutes. Vortex again before plating sample.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"fbbha","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[{"key":0,"offset":0,"length":1}],"data":[]}],"entityMap":{"0":{"type":"duration","mutability":"MUTABLE","data":{"duration":"1800","guid":"EB23C579AB45484697E18367B9392155","id":"11172","label":"bringing phage into solution"}}}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"18muc","text":"Plate dilutions of 10-2 - 10-6. This will help to ensure countable data after incubation.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"sup","offset":21,"length":2},{"style":"sup","offset":28,"length":2}],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"5h3ap","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"3frhr","text":"Incubate overnight at room temperature.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"etm97","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"7a4em","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[{"key":0,"offset":0,"length":1}],"data":[]}],"entityMap":{"0":{"type":"duration","mutability":"MUTABLE","data":{"duration":"57600","guid":"BBCD3A74901A4F32A62B142AAD6043CB","id":"11170","label":"overnight incubation (can be 16-28 hours)"}}}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"6f20l","text":"Pick a plaque from overnight plates for Purification Round 2.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"1h22r","text":"Repeat steps above for one more round of purification. This is purification 3.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"e45e2","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[{"key":0,"offset":0,"length":1}],"data":[]}],"entityMap":{"0":{"type":"duration","mutability":"MUTABLE","data":{"duration":"57600","guid":"0639EBBD02DD4FDB9E05141CA2F9FDEF","id":"11171","label":"overnight incubation (can be 16-28 hours)"}}}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"1thks","text":"Pick plaque from Purification 3 plate using a 200 µl pipette tip. Vortex the pipette tip in 1 mL of phage buffer. Let the sample stand for at least 30 minutes. Vortex again before plating sample. ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"83oqd","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[{"key":0,"offset":0,"length":1}],"data":[]}],"entityMap":{"0":{"type":"duration","mutability":"MUTABLE","data":{"duration":"1800","guid":"3731C58DD8204297A8101D6027DEF014","id":"11173","label":"bringing phage into solution"}}}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"d6q1j","text":"Using a dilution that will lyse 95% of the host lawn, incubate for 24 hours at RT.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"97g91","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"b4lc1","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[{"key":0,"offset":0,"length":1}],"data":[]}],"entityMap":{"0":{"type":"duration","mutability":"MUTABLE","data":{"duration":"86400","guid":"7F6AD62774A84235862421F1131B149A","id":"11174","label":"overnight incubation"}}}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"f5pm9","text":"Identify plates that are 95% lysed. They can be as low as 70%, but completely lysed plates should not be used. Hold plate at an angle, so as not to disturb top agar. Gently pipette 5 mL of phage buffer onto plate. Place on platform shaker at 70 rpm for 30 min to 3 hr at room temperature.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"empmd","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"3nq3f","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"c1ckp","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[{"key":0,"offset":0,"length":1}],"data":[]}],"entityMap":{"0":{"type":"duration","mutability":"MUTABLE","data":{"duration":"1800","guid":"E58E4FF5DCD64D73B392E6608684D727","id":"11175","label":"can be 30 mins to 3 hrs"}}}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"4aile","text":"Phages should now be suspended in buffer. Use a serological pipette to extract liquid into a 15 mL conical tube. If there is solid matter in the sample, centrifuge the sample at 3220 g for 5 min and extract the supernatant.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"4r4uf","text":"Using a 5-10 mL syringe, filter the sample into a new 15 mL conical tube using a 0.8/0.2 um filter (blue and green).","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"5radj","text":"Plate plaque assays on corresponding hosts, at dilutions 10-1 - 10-9.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"sup","offset":59,"length":2},{"style":"sup","offset":66,"length":2}],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"9i3l0","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"38h2p","text":"Incubate plate for 24 hours.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"eddo8","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[{"key":0,"offset":0,"length":1}],"data":[]}],"entityMap":{"0":{"type":"duration","mutability":"MUTABLE","data":{"duration":"86400","guid":"307E3CC57D404C2E88CF3738436CE664","id":"11176","label":"incubation"}}}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"4urkq","text":"Count plaques the following day. If there are fewer than 3 x 10-9 phage / mL, make multiple plate lysates of that phage and concentrate the combined lysate with PEG or Amicon filtration cartridges.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]}],"entityMap":{}}
